title: CT 8: English Language (Fill In The Blanks - Vocabulary - 2)

questions.text:
Direction: There are two blanks in the sentence given below. From the pair of words given in the options, choose the one that fits into the blanks most appropriately.

The proposal met with vehement ______ from all the ______ of the Prime Minister.
questions.explanation:
The correct words to fill the blanks are defiance and denigrators.

Key Points

 Now let us look at the meaning of the correct words:
  • Defiance: open resistance; bold disobedience. It is a noun.
  • Denigrators: a person who criticizes someone or something unfairly. It is a noun.​
Thus both the words of option 1 aptly fit in the context. Here the sentence means that the proposal received intense resistance from the critics of the Prime Minister.

Thus the sentence is: The proposal met with vehement defiance from all the denigrators of the Prime Minister.

Additional Information

Let us look at the meanings of the other options:

Word Meaning
 Appreciation  great respect; reverence
Loyalists a person who remains loyal to the established ruler or government, especially in the face of a revolt
Vehement showing strong feeling; forceful, passionate, or intense
Admiration respect and warm approval
Ingenuity the quality of being clever, original, and inventive
Votaries a devoted follower, adherent, or advocate of someone or something

questions.text:
Directions: There is a blank in the sentence given below. From the words given below, choose the words/word that fits into the blank most appropriately.

It took several hours for the celebrity to _______, but he eventually showed his face at the event.

A. Appear

B. Spearhead

C. Emerge
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'AC.'

Key Points

  • Now let us look at the meaning of the correct words:
    • ​Appear: to come into sight; become visible or noticeable.
    • Emerge: to appear or come out from somewhere.
  • ​Here, both 'A' and 'C' aptly fit in the context of the sentence. The sentence means the celebrity appearing in front of the public at an event after several hours.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 5.

Additional Information

  • The word 'Spearhead' means to lead an attack or movement.

questions.text:
Direction: There are two blanks in the sentence given below. From the pair of words given in the options, choose the one that fits into the blanks most appropriately.

One of the most wonderful ______ of mathematics is that mathematical communication crosses the ______ at which languages stop.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is facets and marges.

Key Points

 Now let us look at the meaning of the correct words:
  • Facets: a particular aspect or feature of something. It is a noun.
  • Marges: an edge; the furthest limit of possibility. It is a noun.​

Thus both the words of option 4 aptly fit in the context. Here the sentence means that mathematical communication is one of the most wonderful feature of mathematics that goes beyond the line at which languages stop.

Thus the sentence is: One of the most wonderful facets of mathematics is that mathematical communication crosses the marges at which languages stop.

Additional Information

Let us look at the meanings of the other options:
Word Meaning
Satire the use of humour, irony, exaggeration, or ridicule to expose and criticize people's stupidity or vices, particularly in the context of contemporary politics and other topical issues.
Ironies the expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite, typically for humorous or emphatic effect.
Borders a line separating two countries, administrative divisions, or other areas
Expediency the quality of being convenient and practical despite possibly being improper or immoral; convenience
Coalesce combine (elements) in a mass or whole; unification; consolidation
Crux the decisive or most important point at issue

questions.text:
Directions: There is a blank in the sentence given below. From the words given below, choose the words/word that fits into the blank most appropriately.

The old lady has received an _______ order from the council for non-payment of rent.

A. Expulsion

B. Eviction

C. Employment
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'AB.'

Key Points

  • Now let us look at the meaning of the correct words:
    • ​Expulsion: the action or process of forcing someone to leave a place.
    • Eviction: the action of expelling or forcing out someone from a property or a place.
  • ​Here, both 'A' and 'B' aptly fit in the context of the sentence. The sentence means the old lady has been forced to leave the place due to non-payment of rent.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Additional Information

  • The word 'Employment' means the state of having paid work or a paid job.

questions.text:
Directions: In the following question, a sentence is given with three blanks. From the options given below, choose the option which contains the most suitable words for the blanks.

Our marketing team will _______ the _______ Annual Sales _______ in Mumbai.

options.text: Tenacious, Upcoming, Convention.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'Organize, Upcoming, Convention.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is about something related to Annual Sales by the marketing team in Mumbai.
  • Therefore, from the given options, the words in the second option will be the most suitable words for the blanks:
    • Organize means To make arrangements or preparations for an event or activity.
    • Upcoming means About to happen; forthcoming.
    • Convention means A large meeting or conference, especially of members of a particular profession or group.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: Our marketing team will organize the upcoming Annual Sales Convention in Mumbai.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore the other options:
    • Malpractice means Improper, illegal, or negligent professional behavior.
    • Tenacious means Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or adhering closely.
    • Impropriety means Failure to observe standards of honesty or modesty; improper behavior or character.
    • Stout means fat and solid-looking; physically or materially strong.

questions.text:
The given question has one blank indicating that something has been omitted. Choose the word from the given options that could fit in the blank correctly.

The Eskimos risked severe _________ as they stepped out of their igloos without any safety gear.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is frostbite

Key Points

  • Frostbite: Injury to body tissue caused by exposure to extreme cold, usually affects the nose, mouth and fingers. 

It should be read as:

The Eskimos risked severe frostbite as they stepped out of their igloos without any safety gear on. 

Important Points

The mention of the terms 'Eskimos' and 'igloos' should give the reader a hint as to the habitat in which Eskimos reside in igloos. 

It is important here that the reader have the general knowledge that Eskimos are native to cold climates. 

Additional Information

Let's look at the meaning of the other words:

  • Sunburn: Reddening and inflammation of the skin due to overexposure to the UV rays of the sun
  • Starvation: Suffering or death caused by hunger
  • Fatigue: Extreme tiredness due to mental and/or physical exertion
  • Pneumonia:  A lung infection cause by a bacteria o

questions.text:
Find out the most effective word from the given options to fill in the blanks of the following questions.

1. She tried to ______ more plants through her house plants.

2. The religious group tried to ______ their beliefs through print and social media.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'propagate'

Key Points

  •  The meaning of the verb 'propagate' is
    • a. to breed specimens of (a plant or animal) by natural processes from the parent stock.
    • b. to spread and promote (an idea, theory, etc.) widely.
  • In the first sentence, the meaning of the word 'Propagate' is that the woman tries to breed specimens of the house plant from the already existing ones.
  • In the second sentence, the meaning of the word 'Propagate' is that the religious group is trying to promote its beliefs through print and social media.

Additional Information

  •  Let us explore the meaning of the given options:
    • Distribute: give a share or a unit of (something) to each of a number of recipients.
    • Suppress: prevent the development, action, or expression of (a feeling, impulse, idea, etc.); restrain.
    • Clone: an organism or cell, or group of organisms or cells, produced asexually from one ancestor or stock, to which they are genetically identical.
    • Broadcast: transmit (a programme or some information) by radio or television.

 

Hence the sentence can be rewritten as:

1. She tried to propagate more plants through her house plants

2. The religious group tried to propagate their beliefs through print and social media.

Hence the correct answer is option 2.

questions.text:
Find out the most effective word from the given options to fill the blanks of the following questions.

1. Experts failed to understand the__________behind the decision to move coal by road when there is enough rail capacity in this sector.
2. The__________that underpins this behavior is that global consumers and investors will buy Amazon's conflict commodities no matter what.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer Rationale. 

Key Points

  • The word 'Rationale' means 'a set of reasons or a logical basis for a course of action or belief'.

Hence, the correct sentences would be:

  1. Experts failed to understand the rationale behind the decision to move coal by road when there is enough rail capacity in this sector.
  2. The rationale that underpins this behavior is that global consumers and investors will buy Amazon's conflict commodities no matter what. 

Additional Information

  •  Option 1) i.e. 'Ideology' means a set of beliefs, especially the political beliefs on which people, parties, or countries base their actions.
    • Example: Naresh says that the election is not about ideology. 
  • ​Option 2) i.e. 'Judgement' means 'the ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions; an opinion or conclusion'.
    • Example: Our judgment as to the cause of his failure must rest on the evidence. 
  • Option 4) i.e. 'Politics' means the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society.
    • Example: Many people think that Trump transformed American politics. 
  • ​Option 5) i.e. 'Logistics' means 'the detailed organization and implementation of a complex operation'.
    • Example: The skills and logistics of getting such a big show on the road pose enormous practical problems.

questions.text:
Two sentences are given below where one word can fill both the blanks. Fill in the blanks with the suitable word from the options.

1. Without any decorations, the Christmas tree looked _______. 

2. A monk chooses to live a/an ______ life because of his religious beliefs
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Austere

Key Points

  •  Let's look at the meaning of the answer (the term has multiple meanings based on the context):
    • Austere: having an extremely plain and simple style or appearance; unadorned
    • Austere: having no comforts or luxuries; harsh or ascetic
  • The first sentence talks about how a Christmas tree looked without any decorations. 
    • The essence of a Christmas tree comes from the tradition of family and friends decorating the tree (with lights, ornaments, etc.) without which it would just be a regular, plain tree and hence not representative of Christmas. 
  • The second sentence talks about how a monk chooses to live a certain type because of his religious beliefs. 
    • Monks are known for their Buddhist lifestyle which involves freedom from all materialistic and worldly possessions and hence leads to a simple, plain life without any pomp or show and often involves the implementation of strict rules and harsh circumstances.  


Thus, the correct answer is Austere

Additional Information

Let's look at the meaning of the other words: 

Word Meaning
Shrunken become or make smaller in size or amount
 Derogatory  showing a critical or disrespectful attitude
Disheveled (of a person's hair, clothes, or appearance) untidy; disordered
Dogmatic inclined to lay down principles as incontrovertibly true


Confusion Points

  • While a monk may have a 'dogmatic' outlook on life, it is impossible a Christmas tree (a non-living thing) would have any kind of perspective on anything.
  • It is possible that a Christmas tree looks 'disheveled' but is impossible to live a 'disheveled' life as it is only something that someone looks like.

questions.text:
Directions: In the following question, a sentence is given with three blanks. From the options given below, choose the option which contains the most suitable words for the blanks.

There is a broad _______ of opinion about the _______ which should be _______.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'Consensus, Policies, Pursued​.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is about a kind of broad opinion about something.
  • Therefore, from the given options, the words in the fourth option will be the most suitable words for the blanks:
    • Consensus means A general agreement.
    • Policies means A course or principle of actions adopted or proposed by an organization or individual.
    • Pursued means To try to achieve something or to continue to do something over a period of time.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: There is a broad consensus of opinion about the policies which should be pursued.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore the other options:
    • Dissent means To hold or express opinions that are at variance with those commonly or officially held.
    • Discord means Disagreement between people.
    • Strife means Angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues; conflict.
    • Hassle means Deliberate harassment.
